gaps.lead: He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ seen his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + had + participle: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: 'I'm sorry I shouted at you,' he said.
gaps.explanation: apologise for doing something: apologised for shouting.

gaps.lead: 'I'll call you as soon as I land,' she said.
gaps.sentence: She promised ___ as soon as she landed.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call (me); pronouns shift.

gaps.lead: I'm sure the tickets are expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: must be = I'm sure it is (deduction).

gaps.lead: It took me two hours to assemble the wardrobe.
gaps.sentence: I ___ two hours assembling the wardrobe.
gaps.explanation: it took + time + to do = subject + spent + time + -ing.
